question: What is the essential nature and status of the sixteen-syllabled Lopā mantra?
premises: Its nature is the unity of consciousness and Brahman and it is auspicious.
inference: The sixteen-syllabled Lopā is an auspicious great vidyā whose essence is the unity of consciousness and Brahman.
plain_english: This sixteen-syllabled mantra is a great and auspicious vidyā, whose very nature is the unity of consciousness and Brahman.
